review.validation_kind: Source inspection by the coding agent; not blinded or a human-subject study.

preliminary_findings.reason: Large repetitive matrix of atomic compare/capture forms, numeric types and memory orders. Flat, repetitive test cases yield a very high count; useful test coverage is not evidence this deserves review ahead of compiler production logic. Leading autogenerated marker refers to FileCheck assertions, not necessarily the entire source. Do not infer all tests should be skipped.

Thousands of lines assembling compiler invocations; interacting target, host/device, language, optimization, sanitizer and diagnostic options. Nested conditions and accumulated command-line state make local edits require cross-case review. Large dispatch responsibility is real, but score is not evidence of a bug or proof it should all be split.

Declarator/type construction with nested declarator-chunk handling, deduction restrictions, language modes, qualifier repair and diagnostics. Requires semantic invariants across branches; parser complexity reflects real review difficulty.
Stateful token consumption, nested switch/loop paths, brace handling and many language-specific exceptions. Multiple early returns and mutation of formatting/token state support prioritization.
Default destructors, empty callback and straight-through delegation to First/Second callbacks. Does not imply lifecycle/order behavior is risk-free.

IR call/intrinsic rewrites depend on volatile/atomic behavior, aliasing, undefined-pointer rules, floating-point modes and operand type. Sampled branches show nested legality guards and mutation of IR, beyond a simple dispatch table.

Demanded-bit simplification recursively updates known masks and rewrites DAG nodes. Type legality, multiple users, vector lanes and shift-width rules create interacting invariants; nested shift/truncate logic supports priority.
Floating-point simplification depends on NaNs, signed zero, denormal modes, demanded classes and fast-math flags. Nested case-specific updates make review require careful semantic checks.

Fortran call-argument validation in C++ combines type/kind/rank, pointer/allocation, intent, polymorphism, language extensions and diagnostic decisions. Several state flags and conditional conversions interact.
Recursive floating-point class inference across constants, vectors and operations. Correct handling of poison, NaNs, sign bits and demanded elements matters to optimization correctness.

preliminary_findings.verdict: Mixed relevance; score inflated by repetitive cases
preliminary_findings.reason: A 256-entry truth-table dispatch with repeated constant-operand guards dominates simplifyTernarylogic. Review is meaningful because rewrites can alter machine semantics, but the source includes explicit truth-table verification and the cases are largely independent. Score 487 should not imply the same entanglement as a deeply nested algorithm.

coverage_examples.cause: LLVM_DUMP_METHOD annotation prefix. Definition in llvm/include/llvm/Support/Compiler.h:685-690 expands to attributes.
LLVM_YAML_IS_SEQUENCE_VECTOR(Param) is a declaration-producing macro with no source semicolon.
Preprocessor directives within an array initializer, generated TypeNodes.inc include.
new (context) CXXCtorInitializer *[NumInitializers]. Reduced probe shows new int *[n] also rejected, while new (p) int[n] parses. Ordinary C++ grammar gap, independent of missing macro definitions.
EMIT_ARITH_OP(Add) expands to statements/break without a semicolon at the callsite.
LLVM_ABI static APInt getSplat(...); export annotation prefix. Entire header is unavailable.
